u235_enrichment_wt_percent.basis: Researcher proposal; BEAVRS endpoint labels are not validation of interpolation

moderator_temperature_K.basis: Researcher proposal; liquid phase and data guards apply

coolant_pressure_MPa.basis: Researcher proposal around general BEAVRS operating pressure

elemental_boron_ppm.basis: Researcher proposal; 975 ppm is sourced HZP point

pin_pitch_cm.basis: Researcher geometry perturbation; not design tolerance

pellet_radius_cm.basis: Researcher geometry perturbation; not design tolerance

insertion_percent.basis: Researcher active-height definition; not source step scale

joint_constraints: IF97 compressed-liquid water at requested temperature and absolute pressure
material nuclear-data temperature tables bracket requested temperatures
pellet radius strictly less than clad inner radius
pin pitch strictly greater than twice the largest pin/guide outer radius
assembly edge-water clearance preserved from source reference
rod insertion percentage between 0 and 100 over active height
production_approval: controlled_research_pilot_only; no physical or training acceptance
